# nginxproxymanager_stream (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
# Forward TCP connections on port 5432 to a database
resource "nginxproxymanager_stream" "example" {
  incoming_port   = 5432
  forwarding_host = "db.local"
  forwarding_port = 5432
  tcp_forwarding  = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `forwarding_host` (String) Host to forward the stream to.
- `forwarding_port` (Number) Port to forward the stream to.
- `incoming_port` (Number) Port the request is coming in on.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Enable or disable the stream.
- `tcp_forwarding` (Boolean) Whether to enable TCP Forwarding
- `udp_forwarding` (Boolean) Whether to enable UDP Forwarding

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) ID of the stream.
- `owner_user_id` (Number) ID of the user which owns the stream.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by the ID shown in the NPM UI or API
terraform import nginxproxymanager_stream.example 1
```
